source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Create a 1 GiB storage file, run gdsio storage-to-GPU mode for GPU index 4 with one worker/1 MiB IO/60 seconds, and compare GDS to non-GDS bandwidth.
procedure_facts: Uses inconsistent `/nvme14n1` and `/nvme11n1/dd1G` paths, a duplicated malformed `/zero` line and only one GDS command.
Exact gdsio flags are `-d 4 -w 1 -s 1G -i 1M -x 0 -I 0 -T 60`; attended 15, machine 5 minutes.
criteria_facts: GDS executes without issue and bandwidth is better than non-GDS.
source_conflicts: Procedure says transfer crosses CPU while `-x 0` is the direct GDS Storage-to-GPU path; no non-GDS command exists; target paths disagree.
missing_source_information: Safe mounted file, stable GPU mapping/topology, GDS compatibility, paired CPU baseline, run order/repetitions and comparison tolerance.

original_test_intent.statement: Demonstrate functional GPUDirect Storage reads from an approved NVMe file into the selected GPU and compare like-for-like GDS throughput with a CPU-mediated path.
must_preserve: 1 GiB data set, 1 MiB IO, one worker, 60-second gdsio GDS read and GDS-versus-non-GDS comparison.
Selected source GPU index 4 must be resolved to a stable physical GPU.
must_not_infer: Unresolved root paths as safe files or raw namespaces.
A DCGM diagnostic as GDS bandwidth evidence or a universal performance advantage.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 prohibits malformed/inconsistent paths and destructive dd, rejects DCGM evidence, and demands safe files, GDS/non-GDS commands, topology and aligned bandwidth criteria.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 conflates current execution readiness with permanent automation capability. Official gdsio supports both GDS (`-x 0`) and traditional CPU (`-x 1`) paths, so after owner-supplied safe target and paired method, the test is automatable rather than inherently BLOCKED.

related_records: Other storage benchmarks do not authorize this target file or prove GDS compatibility.
applicable_history.precedence_application: Malformed source cannot execute, but its GDS-vs-CPU intent and exact workload dimensions are recoverable without changing purpose.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Reclassify capability from BLOCKED: a corrected owner-approved mounted test file and paired `-x 0`/CPU-path commands make it automatable. Execution remains prohibited until path/GPU/topology/method conflicts are resolved.

conditions_present: GDS intent and exact GDS workload size/IO/workers/duration.
missing: Consistent mounted file, data ownership, stable GPU mapping, GDS support, exact non-GDS xfer type, cache/order/repetition/tolerance, cleanup and approval.
provider: Storage/GDS owner supplies safe file/mount and comparison recipe.
GPU owner maps index 4 to UUID/BDF and validates topology/stack.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory mounts/namespaces/data ownership, GPU UUID/BDF/index, PCIe/NUMA/storage topology, CUDA/GDS/gdsio versions and `gdscheck`/configuration without writing.
prohibited_until_resolved: dd or gdsio I/O, using root/raw paths, choosing GPU by stale index, inventing baseline/threshold, cache manipulation, cleanup/deletion or PASS.
closure_evidence: Signed mounted-file path outside protected data, stable GPU map, compatible GDS stack and paired identical-workload comparison policy.

revision_candidate.test_name: Validate GDS Function and Compare CPU-Path Bandwidth
revision_candidate.purpose: Run a 60-second 1 GiB sequential read with one 1 MiB-I/O worker from an approved NVMe test file to the selected GPU through GDS, verify error-free direct-path operation, and compare it with an otherwise identical approved CPU-mediated gdsio path.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact NVIDIA GPU/CUDA/GDS/gdsio, supported filesystem/NVMe mount and PCIe/NUMA topology. The GPU originally named as index 4 must be mapped to a stable UUID/BDF immediately before each run.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One approved disposable/pre-created 1 GiB file on a mounted supported filesystem, never a raw namespace or ambiguous root path; one mapped GPU; paired GDS `-x 0` and owner-selected documented non-GDS xfer type with identical `-w 1 -s 1G -i 1M -I 0 -T 60`. Repetition/order/cache policy must be owner-defined for a defensible comparison.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Signed file/mount/namespace identity and ownership; safe pre-creation/checksum/cleanup method; GPU UUID/BDF/current index and storage/PCIe/NUMA path; compatible CUDA/GDS/gdsio/config; approved CPU-path xfer type; order/warm-up/cache/repetition policy; expected error/tolerance and minimum GDS-over-baseline rule; I/O/thermal/error limits and approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Capture read-only topology, versions, GDS configuration, file identity/checksum, storage/GPU health and logs. Do not use the source's `dd` paths. Under the approved creation method, ensure the disposable file exists. Resolve UUID/BDF to the current gdsio index. Run the GDS case equivalent to `gdsio -f <approved_file> -d <mapped_index> -w 1 -s 1G -i 1M -x 0 -I 0 -T 60`, then the documented owner-approved CPU-mediated xfer type with every other parameter identical, applying the signed order/cache/repetition policy. Preserve raw throughput/latency/IOPS/errors and cleanup only after evidence approval.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Safe mounted test file and capacity; no production-data overlap; compatible GDS stack/topology; stable target map; idle resources; paired method/tolerance, monitoring, stop/recovery and approval ready.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: File mount/device/inode/path/size/checksum/ownership; namespace/filesystem and storage health; CUDA/GDS/gdsio/config versions; GPU UUID/BDF/current index and PCIe/NUMA topology; exact paired commands/order/repetitions/status/times; raw throughput/latency/IOPS/errors for each run; comparison calculation/tolerance; GPU/storage/PCIe/kernel telemetry/log deltas; file integrity and approved cleanup.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Owner-approved GDS compatibility and paired-performance recipe. Pass requires the exact GDS read to complete without cuFile/storage/GPU errors and the statistically defined GDS bandwidth result to exceed the like-for-like CPU baseline by the declared criterion; a single unpaired score or DCGM result is insufficient.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not use `/nvme14n1` or `/nvme11n1/dd1G` without formal path proof, write raw block devices, use stale GPU index, alter production data, call `-x 0` CPU-mediated, change workload between pairs, flush caches without approval, truncate output, substitute DCGM, delete evidence or claim universal GDS superiority.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Storage owner approves file/creation/cleanup; GPU/GDS owner approves topology, xfer modes and comparison; lab approves bounded I/O and recovery.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Agent can run a corrected paired benchmark; data ownership, topology applicability and performance disposition remain engineering decisions.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On path/identity mismatch, I/O/cufile/GPU/PCIe error, hang, data-integrity or health anomaly, stop both paths, preserve partial evidence, leave file/storage untouched, verify GPU/storage/filesystem health and use approved recovery before retry/cleanup.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Ambiguous/raw/protected path; inconsistent source path unresolved; no stable GPU map; unsupported GDS/filesystem/topology; missing paired method/tolerance/approval; file checksum change; I/O/cufile/GPU/AER error; timeout/hang; incomplete output.

No CPU baseline command or comparison policy.
